GREG, 2026-11-10 about 19:42Z, via Asistant 43498a6e #868 (message eaf73641), verbatim: „mysle, ze mozemy wlaczyc Ewaluacje dla Termal, to nasz nastepny etap testow”. Asistant's scope: coordinate turning evaluation on in TermAl's policy, check it in practice on real tasks, and report the confirmation, the result and any defects. Take into account Engram w-89f3's both-stores criterion, and don't treat other EO evidence as automatically closed.
Applied by Engram::Fable at 19:43:17Z on the Central store (ENGRAM_HOME C:\Users\grzeg\.engram), project github.com/grlap/TermAl: allowed_modes [independent_session], mechanical_basis asserted, require_source_freshness false. Policy 67d6efa9 → 5245580e, epoch 7 → 8, authority 4e523517, idempotency key termal-evaluation-on-greg-asistant-868. Same settings as Engram's (rules-greg-evaluation-on-engram-2026-11-09).
So on TermAl too, `done` now needs an independent evaluation. This replaces "evaluation is off" for the TermAl project in rules-greg-control section 3, rules-greg-broken-evaluation-not-blocker-2026-11-01 and rules-authority-and-landing. Other projects (Questly, PhoenixCodeNav, CV, fit_friends and others) stay off until his word.
w-89f3 criterion 3 (on in both stores) closes only after a real TermAl task completes through an independent evaluation on the installed builds, with its result recorded.
